premises.text: Charisma is a simple mobile video messenger for fun, spontaneous real-time interaction
premises.evidence_span: a new one-of-a-kind video messenger app. It's simple. It's mobile. It's fun

premises.text: Signup pre-populates profile and friends from Facebook/Twitter so users skip filling profiles
premises.evidence_span: we pre-populate your profile with your existing data from Facebook and Twitter

premises.text: Users can immediately see and video-call people nearby outside their existing social graph
premises.evidence_span: immediately after you sign up, you would be able to see the people nearby, not only your existing contacts

premises.text: Sparks let reluctant users nudge nearby people to call back; interactions are logged
premises.evidence_span: you can actually send them a spark to encourage them to call you back

premises.text: Unlike questionnaire-heavy dating sites, Charisma enables spontaneous location-based real-time calls with open profiles and filters
premises.evidence_span: You wouldn't be able to do this kind of spontaneous interactions using usual old-school dating sites

premises.text: Launch on Apple then Android; ads-based with subscription to remove ads; also useful for calling nearby stores/bars
premises.evidence_span: They launch on Apple devices, and Android will follow

value.text: Easy spontaneous real-time video interaction with people nearby
value.evidence_span: how easy it is to reach people nearby using Charisma

causal_links.evidence_span: Charisma is mobile. They launch on Apple devices
we are initially ads-based with a subscription to turn out the ads

notes: Mobile/location/social/real-time attributes folded with product differentiation vs dating sites as one nearby-messenger mechanism (§4.1.7). Sparks kept as distinct interaction module that could fail separately from direct call. Pre-populate social graph folded as onboarding facet. Stage demos are evidence of product not separate premises. Singleton D2: ads/subscription commercial model separately revisable.
